responsibility: Implements the standalone generator that derives the TILE constant-multiply optimization tables used by the backend. It enumerates short instruction-expression DAGs built from add/sub/shift-and-add/shift operators, scores competing sequences by schedule length and cost, compresses opcode identities, prunes the result set with architecture-specific heuristics, and emits the generated C table and decode map consumed by tilepro-multiply.h and mul-tables.c for lowering multiplication by compile-time constants.
